plan.title: Recreate Order with Custom Evaluation Duration

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Confirm that the Recreate Order window opened.
Choose the custom evaluation duration mode.
Enter the valid custom duration value of 10.
Confirm that the evaluation duration unit remains Min(s).
Submit the recreated order with the custom duration.
Verify that the order was created successfully and the expected confirmation was shown.
